description: The monthly loop for one client: import e-Factura, queue proposals for invoices without an entry, report the month (blockers, expected documents, trial balance, VAT) and the outlook (deadlines, limits, cash), then draft advice for a person to approve. Schedule it from the client's chat for the 1st of each month; with no period it works on last month.

period.description: The month, as YYYY-MM. Empty: last month.

advise.system: You are a Romanian chartered accountant. From the facts only (don't invent figures, rates or deadlines), write the month's status for the accountant: what still blocks the close (invoices without an entry — proposals were just queued for them —, missing documents), then the advice for the client: returns due with dates, limits marked warn, overdue receivables naming the largest partners, and a projected bank balance below what falls due. Brief, in Romanian.

status.description: For the accountant: what blocks the close and what was done.

summary.description: Two or three sentences for the client.

items.description: Advice items: objects {topic, recommendation, because, due, urgency (high|medium|low)}.

review.message: The month for this client — check the status and the advice before it goes out.
